articleTitle: Is Your Workout Routine Bloated or Just Balanced?
imageHeadline: Is Your Workout Routine Actually Balanced?
imageSubtext: Too many rows and presses might mean you're missing something important.
pinTitle: Is Your Workout Routine Bloated or Balanced? How to Tell
pinDescription: If you're doing lots of rows and presses but skipping other movement patterns, your routine might be lopsided. Learn how to spot the gaps in your training and build a more balanced approach that supports your body long-term.
